home.heroTitle: Learn industry skills, free of cost
home.heroSubtitle: WPBrigade's Free Bootcamp Program gives students hands-on training in AI, web development, and project management and QA - interactive online sessions, real project work, and guidance from people who do this for a living. Finish it and you earn a certificate anyone can verify.
home.feature1Desc: Live sessions you take part in, not recordings you watch on your own. Ask questions and work through problems as they come up.
home.feature2Desc: You build real things. Every track is structured around practical work rather than theory you never get to apply.
home.feature3Desc: Taught by people who do this work daily at WPBrigade, so you learn how it is actually done on real projects.

about.title: About WPBrigade bootcamps
about.subtitle: Who runs these programmes, and why the certificates work the way they do
about.missionBody: WPBrigade has spent years building WordPress products and client work. The bootcamps pass that on — practical training in the things we do daily, run in cohorts and taught by people doing the work.
about.credentialsBody: A certificate is only worth what it can prove. Ours are cryptographically signed and follow Open Badges 3.0, an open standard, so anyone can confirm one is genuine without contacting us — and nobody can forge or quietly alter one.

getStarted.title: Getting started
getStarted.subtitle: How the bootcamps and the certificates work
getStarted.step1Body: Get in touch to find out which bootcamp fits and when the next cohort starts.
getStarted.step2Body: Each programme has criteria to meet. They're listed on the certificate itself, so anyone reading it knows what it took.
getStarted.step3Body: It arrives by email when you finish, with a link to view, download and share it. Your account is created at the same time, using the same address.
